name: halla-ai
description: Halla AI — AI customer experience platform for the GCC/Middle East
author: Call IQ Team

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "gateway,dashboard" -c "cyan,magenta" "npx --yes cross-env PORT=3003 npm run dev -w @halla-ai/gateway" "npx --yes wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3003/health -t 180000 -i 2500 && npx --yes cross-env PORT=3000 npm run dev -w @halla-ai/dashboard"
scripts.dev:dashboard: npx --yes cross-env PORT=3000 npm run dev -w @halla-ai/dashboard
scripts.dev:gateway: npx --yes cross-env PORT=3003 npm run dev -w @halla-ai/gateway
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @halla-ai/types && npm run build -w @halla-ai/db && npm run build -w @halla-ai/memory && npm run build -w @halla-ai/mcp-client
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @halla-ai/gateway && npm run build -w @halla-ai/dashboard && npm run build -w @halla-ai/worker
scripts.test:e2e:flows: node scripts/ensure-local-redis.mjs && playwright test e2e/journeys/dashboard-dataflow.spec.ts e2e/journeys/callflow.spec.ts e2e/journeys/workflow.spec.ts e2e/journeys/dashboard-realtime.spec.ts e2e/api/gateway-dataflow.spec.ts e2e/api/dashboard-realtime-api.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:prod: npx --yes cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=https://app.hallaai.com PLAYWRIGHT_GATEWAY_URL=https://gateway.hallaai.com playwright test e2e/journeys/dashboard-dataflow.spec.ts e2e/journeys/callflow.spec.ts e2e/journeys/workflow.spec.ts e2e/journeys/dashboard-realtime.spec.ts e2e/api/dashboard-realtime-api.spec.ts
scripts.verify:prod: node scripts/production-audit.mjs && node scripts/verify-dashboard-realtime.mjs && node scripts/smoke-production.mjs
scripts.validate:prod: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:prod
scripts.verify:realtime: vitest run tests/integration/dashboard-sync-scopes.test.ts && playwright test e2e/api/dashboard-realtime-api.spec.ts e2e/journeys/dashboard-realtime.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:install: playwright install chromium webkit firefox winldd
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-migrations.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.validate:enterprise: node scripts/validate-migrations.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:cache && npm cache clean --force
scripts.size: du -sh node_modules apps/dashboard/.next 2>/dev/null || echo 'Build folders not found'
scripts.optimize: npm run clean:all && npm install && npm run build
